comments.author: Bael
comments.body:
Red-Stained Sea
1: Speak with City Official
2: From Rio de Janeiro just open the sails without turning, will be heading exactly South. After 3/4 days sailing East of Buenos Aires the battle will begin.
* The item "Introduction to Sailing" for the Memorial Album is a random drop.

comments.author: BIakeC
comments.body: Getting the "Introduction to Sailing" book is only one out of 4 random rewards you can get (the others being Ceasefire agreements, Logwood, and Cochineal) so you might have to take the quest multiple times to get the right one.
